map.体感温度（三分支模型）：气温 T≥27℃ 且湿度 RH≥40% → 炎热指数，R: Apparent temperature (three-branch model): T≥27℃ and RH≥40% → heat index, the Rothfusz regression (evaluated as a Fahrenheit polynomial then converted back to Celsius, including the low-humidity correction for RH<13 and 80≤Tf≤112 and the high-humidity correction for RH>85 and 80≤Tf≤87); T≤10℃ and wind >1.3 m/s → wind chill 35.74+0.6215Tf−35.75·V^0.16+0.4275·Tf·V^0.16 (V in mph = wind m/s×2.23694, with <3 taken as 3); otherwise apparent ≈ actual air temperature. Validation: any of the three inputs being non-numeric clears and returns. Grading (℃): ≥54 extreme danger, ≥41 danger, ≥32 extremely hot, ≥27 hot, ≥10 comfortable–warm, ≥0 cool, ≥−10 cold, otherwise freezing.
